test_objective: Verify that ACC maintains ego speed within ±0.5 m/s of the driver-set speed when the lead vehicle is absent or faster, after a 5 s settling period.
assumptions: Lead vehicle is absent for the entire test duration
Driver-set speed remains constant at 20 m/s
Road is straight, level, and free of curvature
rationale: By removing the lead vehicle at time zero, the ACC controller operates in a steady‑state cruise mode. After the 5 s settling period the test checks that the ego speed error stays within the ±0.5 m/s tolerance, confirming compliance with the requirement.
